producerAndLifetime: PocoUser.Roles is initially a mutable List through ICollection; PocoRole has mutable virtual string Id/Name/NormalizedName.

UserManager.AddToRolesCoreAsync iterates roles.Distinct(), normalizes each name, checks current membership and calls the same store's AddToRoleAsync. The store appends a PocoUserRole referencing actual user/role IDs.
InMemoryUserStore.CreateAsync/UpdateAsync assign user objects to an instance dictionary; Users is that dictionary's Values.AsQueryable(). Store and user collections are not static.

The inherited test explicitly requests one fresh context. FunctionalTest independently demonstrates one store per created host registered as singleton, not a process-global user population. Neither lifetime was executed.
semanticsToPreserve: Store roleName null/empty validation occurs before scanning roles. Role selection invokes NormalizedName.Equals and SingleOrDefault: multiple matching names throw, and an evaluated null NormalizedName can throw. Unknown role returns a new empty user list without scanning users.

Membership compares string RoleId to role.Id by existing string value equality, case-sensitively; do not substitute the role-name comparer. Manager NormalizeName delegates to its configured KeyNormalizer, or returns the name unchanged.

Any short-circuits each user's role sequence. Duplicate membership entries do not duplicate that outer user result. Do not add a Distinct on the outer dictionary values or change user-reference identity.

ToList preserves existing outer enumeration order and eagerly materializes the matching user references before returning a completed Task. Do not sort, defer the query, or change synchronous exception timing.

The store currently ignores its CancellationToken; the ordinary UserManager property defaults to CancellationToken.None and is virtual. Do not introduce cancellation behavior or alter exception/async semantics.

semanticsToPreserve: Credential equality is ordered byte content via SequenceEqual, not byte[] reference equality or an unverified string encoding. Distinct arrays with equal bytes match, and zero-length arrays are content-equal.

FirstOrDefault selects the first matching user in existing Users enumeration order; Any short-circuits within each user. No captured store code enforces cross-user credential uniqueness; do not change which user wins when equal credentials exist across users.

Duplicate passkeys within one user do not duplicate the returned user. AddOrUpdate searches that user's first matching entry; direct public mutable collection/credential properties permit states beyond manager-mediated writes.

ToPocoUserPasskey retains the input CredentialId array reference. PocoUser.Passkeys is a mutable ICollection and PocoUserPasskey.CredentialId is a public mutable virtual byte[] property. No immutability or index invalidation invariant was established.

A miss returns null inside an already completed Task after eager synchronous traversal; preserve existing order, reference identity, short-circuiting and synchronous exception timing. The direct store has no credential null guard, while UserManager guards before delegation.
The store ignores its CancellationToken. Do not add cancellation or change async, null/error or disposal behavior during any future optimization.
